description: The bar chart illustrates token counts (in thousands) across several text categories for a dataset referenced in the paper, showing how many tokens are associated with each category. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled “Categories,” with diagonally rotated tick labels; the categories appear in the order Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, (an unlabeled category position), Science, and Blogs. The vertical axis is the value axis labeled “Tokens (K),” using a linear scale ranging from 0 up to a little above 10,000, with regularly spaced tick marks at 2,000-token intervals. Each category is represented by a single light-blue vertical bar with a dark-blue numeric value label above it: Administrative is approximately 6,472K, Religion 652K, Non-fiction 1,889K, Fiction 387K, Law 354K, the unlabeled category has the tallest bar at 10,584K, Science is 1,626K, and Blogs is the shortest at 32K. There is no legend and no stacked or grouped structure; bars are not sorted by height and no bar is specially outlined, though the unlabeled category’s bar area includes a faint gray shading behind it.
